parameters.query:
WITH sup AS (
  INSERT INTO suppression (email, reason)
  SELECT $1, $2
  WHERE $2 <> ''
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppression WHERE lower(email) = lower($1))
  RETURNING 1
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE contacts c
     SET email_status = $3, last_action_at = now()
    FROM campaigns g
   WHERE $3 <> ''
     AND c.campaign_id = g.id
     AND g.smartlead_campaign_id = $4
     AND lower(c.email) = lower($1)
     AND (
       ($3 = 'sent_email' AND c.email_status = 'sending')
       OR ($3 IN ('replied','bounced') AND c.email_status IN ('sending','sent_email'))
     )
  RETURNING 1
)
INSERT INTO events (contact_id, channel, event_type, payload)
SELECT NULL, 'email', $5,
       jsonb_build_object('email', $1::text, 'reason', $2::text,
                          'new_status', $3::text, 'smartlead_campaign_id', $4::text,
                          'source', 'smartlead_webhook',
                          'suppressed', (SELECT count(*) FROM sup) > 0,
                          'status_updated', (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) > 0)
 WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM sup) > 0 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) > 0;
